verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs directly target this use case with a guide to "trace how a repo fits together and find the right places to start". Cloud agents can "inspect the full workspace", and subagents work across different parts of a codebase in their own context windows, which suggests the agent can explore a repo autonomously. However, the evidence is a single headline plus indirect capabilities, with no detail on how the agent gathers context by itself. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of automatic codebase indexing/semantic search or context retrieval without manual file selection, in-depth docs on whole-repo mapping/explanation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
